name: densitymode-simple
description: Simple ladder for the densityMode flag (pro tier, default true): the 'Density' segmented control in the Appearance popover is hidden in Simple, present in Pro; clicking Compact/Comfortable there is a real DOM click that flows through setDensity -> editorPrefs' effect, which writes the EFFECTIVE density onto <html data-density> only while the flag resolves on (the flag gates the *effect*, not just the preference, per editorPrefs.ts's own comment) — so a Compact pick made in Pro is provably suppressed back to 'comfortable' the moment the app returns to Simple, even though the underlying preference is still 'compact'.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-density-section-hidden-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const label = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pop-label')].find(l => l.textContent.trim() === 'Density'); if (label) throw new Error('Density section visible in Simple mode (densityMode is pro-tier, should be forced off)'); })()

steps.name: verify-data-density-still-comfortable-in-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const eff = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-density'); if (eff !== 'comfortable') throw new Error('data-density is \'' + eff + '\' in Simple mode even though densityMode is pro-tier — the flag should force the EFFECT to comfortable regardless of the stored preference'); })()

steps.name: verify-density-section-present-pro
steps.eval: (function(){ const label = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pop-label')].find(l => l.textContent.trim() === 'Density'); if (!label) throw new Error('Density section missing in Pro mode'); })()

steps.name: verify-data-density-now-compact
steps.eval: (function(){ const eff = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-density'); if (eff !== 'compact') throw new Error('data-density did not switch to compact once Pro resolved densityMode on, got: ' + eff); })()

steps.name: verify-forced-comfortable-again-in-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const eff = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-density'); if (eff !== 'comfortable') throw new Error('data-density did not revert to comfortable after switching back to Simple, got: ' + eff); const pref = window.__store.getState().density; if (pref !== 'compact') throw new Error('Underlying density preference was not preserved across the mode switch, got: ' + pref); })()
